_comment: Known defects inherited from upstream 2.2. Reported but not failing, so new violations are visible. This ledger only shrinks - remove entries as the referenced issues are fixed. Regenerate deliberately, never to silence a new failure.

armor-curve.issue: #318 for the four vanilla merges (Zetachrome Apex, Gloves, Pumps and Lune) and the eight vambraces, #319 for the four shields. The four cloaks at AV 3 are the other half of the cloaks-stay-vambraces-go decision in docs/DESIGN_balance.md 9.3, which caps Back at 2; they belong with #318's fix. Every one of these predates the ceiling being written down in 3.2.1.

item-curve.issue: #338 for the 108 chips (the chip curve is settled in docs/STYLEGUIDE.md 3.2.1; the reprice is that issue's work), #373 for the 22 other items. Both became visible only when #354 made item-curve prefer the Tier tag over a material word in the blueprint name - they are not new defects, they are defects the check could not previously see.
